changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Asset' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AllocationUid') begin alter table metrics.Asset add AllocationUid uniqueidentifier null; end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Asset' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetTypeUid') begin update T set T.AllocationUid = S.Uid from metrics.Asset T inner join metrics.Allocation S on S.AssetTypeUid = T.AssetTypeUid and S.ScoreType = T.ScoreType;
alter table metrics.Asset alter column AllocationUid uniqueidentifier not null;
alter table [metrics].[Asset] with check add constraint [FK_MetricAsset_MetricAllocation] foreign key([AllocationUid]) references [metrics].[Allocation] ([Uid]) on delete cascade alter table [metrics].[Asset] check constraint [FK_MetricAsset_MetricAllocation] end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Asset' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetTypeUid') begin alter table metrics.Asset drop column AssetTypeUid; end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Asset' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ScoreType') begin alter table [metrics].[Asset] drop constraint [DF_MetricScore_ScoreType] alter table metrics.Asset drop column ScoreType; end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Asset' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Name') begin alter table metrics.Asset alter column Name nvarchar(250) null; end
if exists (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] drop constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset] end GO
if exists (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion] end GO
if exists (select * from sys.key_constraints where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersion') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] drop constraint [PK_MetricAssetVersion] end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetUid') begin exec sp_rename 'metrics.AssetVersion.Uid', 'AssetUid', 'COLUMN' end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetUid') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] with check add constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset] foreign key([AssetUid]) references [metrics].[Asset] ([Uid]) on delete cascade alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] check constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset] end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Uid') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add [Uid] uniqueidentifier constraint DF_MetricAssetVersion_Uid default(newid()) not null end GO
if not exists (select * from sys.key_constraints where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersion') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add constraint [PK_MetricAssetVersion] primary key nonclustered ( [Uid] asc ) end GO
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' and CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'UQ_MetricsAssetVersion') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add constraint UQ_MetricsAssetVersion unique ( AssetUid, EffectiveDate ); end GO
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersion') begin create clustered index CIX_MetricsAssetVersion on [metrics].[AssetVersion] ( AssetUid asc, EffectiveDate desc ) end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Name') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add [Name] nvarchar(250) constraint DF_MetricAssetVersion_Name default('') not null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Description') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add [Description] nvarchar(4000) null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Threshold') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add [Threshold] float null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'UpdateFrequency') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add UpdateFrequency int constraint DF_MetricAssetVersion_UpdateFrequency default(0) not null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'MatchConditionsOnly') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] add MatchConditionsOnly bit constraint DF_MetricAssetVersion_MatchConditionsOnly default(1) not null end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Internal') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] drop constraint [DF_MetricAssetVersion_Internal] alter table [metrics].[AssetVersion] drop column Internal end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Name') begin update T set T.Name = S.Name, T.Description = S.Description from metrics.AssetVersion T inner join metrics.Asset S on S.Uid = T.AssetUid end GO
if exists (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_FieldType') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_FieldType] end GO
if exists (select * from sys.key_constraints where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop constraint [PK_MetricAssetVersionCondition] end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetVersionUid') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add AssetVersionUid uniqueidentifier constraint DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_AssetVersionUid default(newid()) not null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetUid') begin exec sp_rename 'metrics.AssetVersionCondition.Uid', 'AssetUid', 'COLUMN' end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Uid') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add [Uid] uniqueidentifier constraint DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_Uid default(newid()) not null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'MatchType') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add MatchType int constraint DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MatchType default(1) not null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Position') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add Position int constraint DF_MetricAssetVersionCondition_Position default(1) not null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Threshold') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add Threshold float null end GO
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Weight') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add [Weight] decimal(5,3) null end GO
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersionCondition') begin create clustered index CIX_MetricsAssetVersionCondition on [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] ( AssetVersionUid, [Position] asc ) end GO
create table #Conditions ( Uid uniqueidentifier not null, AssetVersionUid uniqueidentifier not null, AssetVersionConditionUid uniqueidentifier not null, MatchType int not null, EffectiveDate date not null, ValueJson nvarchar(250) ) GO
insert into #Conditions select newid(), V.Uid, C.Uid, iif(ConditionAndOr = 'a', 2, 1) as MatchType, C.EffectiveDate, C.ValueJson from metrics.AssetVersionCondition C inner join metrics.AssetVersion V on V.AssetUid = C.AssetUid and V.EffectiveDate = C.EffectiveDate group by V.Uid, C.Uid, ConditionAndOr, C.EffectiveDate, C.ValueJson GO
insert into [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] (Uid, AssetVersionConditionUid, ConditionType, ConditionFieldTypeID, ConditionIntersectTypeID, Operator) select newid(), C.Uid as AssetVersionConditionUid, 1 as ConditionType, VC.FieldTypeID as ConditionFieldTypeID, null as ConditionIntersectTypeID, VC.Operator from #Conditions C inner join metrics.AssetVersionCondition VC on VC.Uid = C.AssetVersionConditionUid GO
truncate table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] GO
insert into [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] (Uid, [Value]) select C.Uid, VC.ValueJson from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] C inner join #Conditions VC on VC.Uid = C.AssetVersionConditionUid GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'EffectiveDate') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop column [EffectiveDate] end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'FieldTypeID') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop column [FieldTypeID] end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Operator') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop column [Operator] end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ValueJson') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop column [ValueJson] end GO
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionCondition' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetUid') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop column [AssetUid] end GO
insert into [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] (Uid, AssetVersionUid, MatchType) select Uid, AssetVersionUid, MatchType from #Conditions GO
if exists (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] drop constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion] end GO
if not exists (select * from sys.key_constraints where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] add constraint [PK_MetricAssetVersionCondition] primary key nonclustered ( [Uid] ASC ) end GO
if not exists (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] with check add constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion] foreign key([AssetVersionUid]) references [metrics].[AssetVersion] ([Uid]) on delete cascade alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] check constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionCondition_MetricAssetVersion] end GO
if not exists (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] with check add constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition] foreign key([AssetVersionConditionUid]) references [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] ([Uid]) on delete cascade alter table [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] check constraint [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition] end
